user_query.title: sqlite-db-truncate
user_query.text: I have a sqlite database in /app/trunc.db that was corrupted through binary truncation. Recover as many of the rows as possible, and create a JSON file in /app/recover.json. The output should have the format [{"word": "testwordXY", "value": M}, {"word": "testwordZZ","value": N}, ...]

- Bytes 3-4: number of cells
